svg.title: One campaign launched at 20:00 UTC meets three users in different time zones
svg.desc: Quiet hours are 22:00 to 08:00 local time. At 20:00 UTC it is 01:30 in Mumbai, so the send waits until 02:30 UTC; 20:00 in London, so it is sent now; 07:00 in Sydney, so it waits until 21:00 UTC.
svg.text: campaign at 20:00 UTC, quiet hours 22:00–08:00 local
UTC, overnight into the next day
